name: Sign Language Translator
description: Real-time sign language translation for live video meetings with webcam subtitles, personalized gesture model training, complete ASL & ISL dictionary with HD videos, an AI Sign Evaluator with personalized practice recommendations and weak gesture biomechanical analysis, competitive Multiplayer Practice Arena, Global Leaderboards with daily/weekly leagues, achievement badges, customizable practice reminders & notifications, an advanced Gesture Search engine supporting keyword lookup, category browsing, visual image-based reverse sign search, and fast filtering, alongside an interactive Learning Dashboard.
